# `timestamp_millis`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
timestamp_millis(milliseconds)
```

Creates timestamp from the number of milliseconds since UTC epoch.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- timestamp_millis, example 1
> SELECT timestamp_millis(1230219000123);
2008-12-25 07:30:00.123
```
